tasks.label: Framework: Install VS Code Skills
tasks.detail: Installs VS Code skills provided by the custom devcontainer framework when available.
tasks.command: bash -lc 'if [ -f /opt/devcontainer/installer/install.sh ]; then bash /opt/devcontainer/installer/install.sh && node /opt/devcontainer/installer/skills/index.js; else echo "[Framework] Installer is not available in this devcontainer. Task skipped."; fi'

tasks.label: Framework: Sync Global Agent Assets
tasks.detail: Refreshes the machine-wide agent skills and commands shared by every devcontainer on this host; fails if the sync itself fails, skips silently when the framework is absent.
tasks.command: bash -lc 'if [ -f /opt/devcontainer/sync-agent-assets.sh ]; then bash /opt/devcontainer/sync-agent-assets.sh; else echo "[Framework] Installer is not available in this devcontainer. Task skipped."; fi'
